productName: Helm Bridge — unified cross-sport command center at /admin
routeEntry: /admin (new top-level route group src/app/admin/*; NOT /monitoring — that path is reserved by Sentry's tunnelRoute rewrite in next.config.mjs)
summary: Helm Bridge is ONE server-rendered command center at /admin that replaces /golf/admin and /baseball/admin (the CRM subtree at /golf/admin/crm is carved out and untouched). It is a triage inbox plus health strip, not a BI wall: a pinned worst-severity banner and 6-tile KPI strip answer 'is anything on fire?' in under 5 seconds, a merged Sentry + admin_events triage queue (grouped by fingerprint, ranked by affected users, deploy-correlated) is the centerpiece, and 8 tabs give drill-down over errors, auth, golf (Fairway-inked), baseball + Lift Lab (Living Annual-inked), users/teams, cron/data-integrity, and Vercel deploys. It is built once from the existing Fairway component kit (AppShell, MetricCard, StatTile, DataTable, ChartFrame, InstrumentPanel) with sport accent inks as wayfinding — no third design language. Access is a Nick-only allowlist enforced at middleware (src/proxy.ts), a shared requireSuperAdmin() helper first-line in every server entry point, and deny-by-default RLS backed by a new is_super_admin() SQL function. Observability extends the MATURE existing pipeline (admin_events 90,796 rows + error_logs 88,764 rows + lib/admin-logger.ts + lib/server-error-logger.ts used by 237 files) with the four missing capture classes (RLS denials, failed-server-action wrapper, full auth event coverage, cron/integrity outcomes into the empty background_job_logs scaffold), and adds the two greenfield integrations: a server-only Sentry REST client (new SENTRY_READ_TOKEN) and the Vercel deployments API (token vars already consumed by admin-data.ts:1563, likely just need setting). Everything ships in small Sonnet PR waves after owner approval; migrations are additive-only against the shared prod DB with post-migration ACL verification.

authModel.approach: Single super-admin allowlist (Nick only, by auth user-id primary / email secondary), enforced at three independent layers. Mechanism: (1) a new admin_allowlist table (one row: Nick's auth.users id + email), RLS deny-all, service_role-managed, plus a mirrored server-only env var SUPER_ADMIN_USER_IDS for zero-DB-roundtrip checks; (2) a new SQL function public.is_super_admin() = EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_allowlist WHERE user_id = auth.uid()), SECURITY DEFINER with pinned search_path, EXECUTE revoked from anon (grant to authenticated only so RLS policies can call it), replacing users.role='admin' as the gate for everything under /admin. The legacy role column keeps gating the old /golf/admin (and the untouched CRM) until retirement. Layer order per request: middleware redirect (cheap filter, never trusted alone — Next middleware has had bypass CVEs) → requireSuperAdmin() helper called FIRST LINE in the /admin layout server component, every /admin page, every server action, and every /api/admin-center route handler (verifies supabase.auth.getUser() then compares user.id against the env allowlist; only after passing may code touch createAdminClient()) → Postgres RLS deny-by-default on all new tables (ENABLE + FORCE, zero anon/authenticated policies; service-role reads happen only behind the gated server layer) with the single writable mutation (resolve/acknowledge an event) exposed as a SECURITY DEFINER RPC that internally checks is_super_admin(), with EXECUTE revoked from anon and verified via pg_proc ACLs post-migration.
changes: NEW: src/proxy.ts + src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts gain an /admin/* matcher: getUser() → compare user.id to SUPER_ADMIN_USER_IDS → redirect to /golf/login (today ZERO admin-path logic exists in middleware — confirmed in both files)

NEW: shared src/lib/admin/require-super-admin.ts helper (both throwing and non-throwing probe variants — preserve the checkAdminAccess non-throwing-probe pattern from admin-data.ts:95-125 that prevented the documented 500-flood incident), replacing the per-file copy-pasted requireAdmin() functions
NEW MIGRATION: admin_allowlist table + is_super_admin() function; seed with Nick's user id (needs owner to confirm WHICH auth account is his — see openQuestions)

SECURITY FIX (pre-req, its own PR): handle_new_user() trigger casts raw_user_meta_data->>'role' into users.role and 'admin' is a valid enum value — a direct Supabase signup call could self-mint admin; restrict the cast to player|coach before /admin ships
PROD DATA CHANGE (owner approval): downgrade the stale test admin row admin-ui-1779052548996@golfhelm.local (one of only 2 users.role='admin' rows)
iOS: add /admin to the AdminNativeGuard / proxy.ts native-UA exclusion so Apple reviewers never see it (App Store 4.2.2/3.1.1 — same guard the golf admin uses)

RLS hygiene: every new migration ends with REVOKE ALL FROM anon, authenticated on new objects + a pg_class.relacl / pg_proc ACL verification query (documented recurring failure mode: agents ship GRANT ALL TO anon; matview/table recreates auto-re-grant)

SECURITY DEFINER rollup RPC discipline: the 11 existing get_admin_*_rollup functions internally check auth.uid() role and 'Forbid' under service_role JWTs (documented 509-storm at admin-data.ts:35-44) — new /admin calls them with the admin's user-scoped client, exactly as rollup-a.ts does today; also REVOKE the 49 anon-executable SECURITY DEFINER functions flagged by the advisor (incl. is_admin, get_admin_platform_stat_averages) in a hardening wave
enforcementLayers: Middleware (src/proxy.ts → lib/supabase/middleware.ts): /admin/* matcher, getUser() + user.id ∈ SUPER_ADMIN_USER_IDS, redirect on failure — first filter only, never the sole gate

Server (route handlers / server actions / server components): requireSuperAdmin() first-line in every entry point under src/app/admin and src/app/api/admin-center; all Sentry/Vercel API calls and all createAdminClient() service-role reads live strictly behind this gate so tokens and data never reach an unauthorized response

Postgres RLS: is_super_admin() SQL function + deny-by-default policies on admin_allowlist and all new objects; admin_events/error_logs keep their existing service_role-INSERT policies; the resolve mutation is a SECURITY DEFINER RPC gated on is_super_admin() with anon EXECUTE revoked and ACLs verified after every migration

informationArchitecture.purpose: Level-1 'is anything on fire?' screen — pinned status banner, KPI strip, unified triage queue, deploy rail, watch-the-watcher. Hard-capped at ~10 tiles, no scrolling on desktop; every number deep-links to a filtered tab.

widgets.name: Global status banner
widgets.dataSource: Server-side rollup: Sentry issues API (unresolved count) + admin_events (unresolved error/critical) + background_job_logs (overdue crons) + latest integrity results
widgets.description: Single worst-severity line: green 'All systems nominal' / red 'N items need attention', with last-refreshed timestamp. Rendered as a dark Fairway InstrumentPanel strip — the sanctioned on-dark cockpit — visually marking 'admin mode'.

widgets.name: KPI strip (6 MetricCards)
widgets.dataSource: Sentry org issues endpoint; admin_events (24h errors); login_attempts + admin_events security/login rows; users.last_seen + admin_analytics_events (active today); golf_rounds + baseball_games + helm_lifting_sessions counts (service-role head:true counts); Vercel v6 deployments (latest prod state)
widgets.description: Unresolved Sentry issues, event-log errors 24h, auth failures/lockouts, active users today, activity today (rounds+games+lifts split by sport ink), last deploy status. Each: Fragment Mono numeral, delta vs prior window, sparkline, severity dot+icon (never color-only).

widgets.name: Unified triage queue (largest bento tile, ~2/3 width)
widgets.dataSource: Merged: Sentry issues (is:unresolved, new/regressed/escalating substatus, userCount) + admin_events grouped by lib/admin/incident-grouping.ts fingerprints (unresolved only, partial index)
widgets.description: One worklist sorted by affected users then recency — never a flat event feed. Rows: severity icon, source badge (Sentry/App), sport badge (green golf / clay baseball), event count, distinct users, first/last seen, 'since deploy <sha>' badge, inline acknowledge/resolve (ports resolveDashboardIncident, admin-data.ts:1150) or Sentry permalink.

widgets.name: Regressed-issues callout
widgets.dataSource: Sentry issues API filtered to substatus regressed
widgets.description: Dedicated strip for resolved-then-returned issues — the highest-signal error category (a fix failed). Renders celebratory all-clear when empty.

widgets.name: Deploy rail
widgets.dataSource: Vercel API GET /v6/deployments?projectId&teamId&limit=10 (state, git sha/branch/message, target=production) + Sentry issues filtered by release for new-issue counts
widgets.description: Last 5 production deploys with commit link, age, state, and error-rate delta in the first hour post-deploy. Answers 'what changed?' — ~19% of incidents are deploy regressions.

widgets.name: Watch-the-watcher meta widget
widgets.dataSource: In-app: timestamp of last successful Sentry API pull (cached fetch metadata); MAX(created_at) per admin_events event_type; background_job_logs expected-vs-actual
widgets.description: Staleness detection: 'no login rows in 24h' means logging broke (sign-ins definitely happened). Sentry pull failure and event-type staleness render amber STALE — a silent dashboard is indistinguishable from a healthy system.

informationArchitecture.purpose: Full error drill-down: every Sentry issue and every in-app incident, grouped, filterable, deploy-correlated, with per-issue affected users/teams.

informationArchitecture.purpose: Every scheduled job's outcome with dead-cron detection, plus a data-integrity check ledger — the class of silent failure (recorded-but-unran migrations, schema drift, grant drift) that has repeatedly bitten this codebase.

widgets.name: Cron board (expected vs actual)

widgets.description: The event log watching itself: table growth vs retention policy (info 90d / error+critical 13mo, deleted by a Vercel cron — no pg_cron exists in this DB), so the console can never bloat the shared prod instance.

errorTracking.inAppEventLog: EXTEND admin_events — do not build a parallel table. It already has event_type/severity/title/message/metadata jsonb/user_id/stack_trace/resolved workflow, service_role-only INSERT RLS, Realtime streaming, and three mature writers (lib/admin-logger.ts server, lib/server-error-logger.ts dual-writing Sentry+DB from 237 files, POST /api/admin/log-event client entrypoint with type-allowlist + severity clamping + rate limit). Net-new capture classes: (1) rls_denial — centralize 42501/PGRST error-code detection in the shared Supabase result helpers (fetchAllRowsResult et al.) logging {table, verb, code, userId}; (2) server_action_failed — a withAdminObserved wrapper generalizing the existing with-baseball-action/with-lifting-action patterns: Sentry.withServerActionInstrumentation + captureException once (skipping NEXT_REDIRECT/NEXT_NOT_FOUND control-flow via isRedirectError) + fire-and-forget admin_events insert (own try/catch or next/server after() — logging must NEVER fail a user request); retrofit mutation-heavy actions first (round submit, lineup save, lift check-in); (3) auth coverage — extend logLogin/logSignup to every auth path including failures and password resets (today only 12 login rows/7d), plus an edge-safe emitter for middleware updateSession failures (currently console.warn-swallowed; server-error-logger's createAdminClient is not edge-safe — use a fire-and-forget fetch to an internal route); (4) cron/integrity — wrap all 14 vercel.json cron routes to write background_job_logs + admin_events source='cron'/'integrity'. Fire-and-forget, append-only, retention cron from day one (info 90d, error/critical 13mo; no pg_cron in this DB — Vercel cron route).
errorTracking.sentry: Greenfield server-side pull (SDK ingest is already complete: instrumentation.ts node+edge with onRequestError, instrumentation-client.ts with replay + per-sport tagging, withSentryConfig source maps + automaticVercelMonitors). uxDirection.designSystem: Build ONCE from the existing Fairway kit (src/components/fairway: AppShell warm-black rail + glass top bar, PageContainer/ViewHeader, MetricCard with NumberFlow odometers, StatTile with the InsufficientData honesty contract, DataTable with skeleton/empty/error states, ChartFrame + TrendChart/Sparkline over Recharts dynamic-imported ssr:false, StatusPill/InlineNotice/tone.tsx, ⌘K command-menu, InstrumentPanel dark cockpit). NO third design language and NO shadcn CLI (no components.json — hand-maintained kit). Severity uses the fw-status trio exclusively (fw-danger/fw-warning/fw-success) always paired with icon shape + text label, never color alone. Fragment Mono tabular numerals (font-fw-mono, text-stat-lg) on every metric. Obey the encoded hard rules: no white cards, Fairway radius ramp only, border-OR-shadow at rest, accent never blue/violet, every chart gets ChartFrame's table fallback.
uxDirection.layout: Inverted pyramid on an asymmetric 12-column bento grid. Row 0: pinned dark InstrumentPanel status banner (the one sanctioned on-dark surface — instantly signals 'admin mode' against the shared prod DB). Row 1: 6-tile MetricCard KPI strip. Middle: triage queue at ~2/3 width left, regressed callout + deploy rail + watch-the-watcher stacked on the right rail. Level 2 = the 8 tabs (server components per-panel — retiring the 989-line 'use client' monolith and the single ~90-field AdminDashboardData blob in favor of the slice-RPC + degraded-flags pattern already proven in rollup-a/b/c). Level 3 = detail drawers/pages with deep links out to Sentry/Vercel. Every Level-1 number links to a pre-filtered Level-2 URL; filter chips (sport, window, severity) persist in the URL so drill-downs are deep-linkable. Overview hard-capped at ~10 tiles; fixed tile heights so polling never reflows the grid.
uxDirection.theming: Fairway ops chrome, sport-inked lanes: warm-black nav rail (--fw-color-nav-bg) + bg-canvas-gradient cream page as the neutral shell; sport-scoped rows/cards/sections tagged with the sport's INK as wayfinding only — helm green rule/InkBadge for golf, infield-clay #C2703D (--pursuit-ink) for baseball, per Living Annual's two-ink law. Baseball drill-down panes wrap in .living-annual so the same Fairway primitives self-skin deeper cream + Space Grotesk automatically (the scope class literally re-points --fw-* vars). Never blend the two palettes on one surface; never apply .living-annual to shared panes. Oxblood for seals only, sodium as a single PR flash, --clay dark canvas only inside ClayCanvas viz frames.
keyInteractions: 30–60s SWR polling per panel (NOT websockets) with visibility-aware pause; per-panel 'updated Xs ago' ticking chips; one global manual-refresh; Supabase Realtime kept ONLY for the admin_events triage stream (existing useAdminRealtime pattern) after verifying admin_events SELECT RLS doesn't leak payloads to non-admin authenticated users

Explicit amber STALE overlay with last-known-good data when any upstream fetch fails (Sentry hiccup must never blank a panel) — panel-level Suspense + error boundaries with per-panel retry; the monitor must be more reliable than the monitored

Celebratory timestamped all-clear states for zero-error panels ('No errors in the last 24h — last checked 12s ago'); three visually distinct cases: all-clear (green), no-data-yet (neutral), fetch-failed (amber)
Inline triage actions on queue rows: acknowledge/resolve/ignore (writes resolved_by + audit_log row) or open-in-Sentry permalink; aggregate related events into one line, never 14 rows
⌘K command menu for jump-to-user/team/issue; keyboard shortcuts 1–8 for tabs and R for refresh (preserving the old admin's muscle memory)
